purpose: Teach: テナント/争議/励まさ/数回/封じ/裏付ける/先代/小論文

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、大学の、本気で、絶対、テナント、絶対、施設、絶対、調査、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren—survey the university tenants and facilities thoroughly. Proceed with absolute seriousness. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Steady, measured authority. Direct eye contact. Each clause lands with quiet weight. Expectant silence at the end—this is not a request.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学界の、本気で、絶対、争議、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm documenting the academic disputes that the papers address. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Respectful but not deferential. Clear and methodical. Slight pause before each key point—showing he's thought this through. Genuine gratitude, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 教授から、本気で、絶対、励まされ、絶対、た、絶対、ことを、絶対、忘れるなよ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Don't forget what your professor told you—how they encouraged you to keep going. That matters.
lines.style: Softer than before. Less command, more reminder. Slight lean forward. The words themselves are simple but delivered as if he's making sure it lands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験を、本気で、絶対、数回、絶対、繰り返して、絶対、再現性、絶対、確認しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm running the experiments multiple times to verify the reproducibility of the results.
lines.style: Even pacing. Technical precision without rushing. Quiet confidence in each step. The tone of someone who knows what careful work looks like.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文情報を、本気で、絶対、封じる、絶対、必要、絶対、ないが、絶対、慎重にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: You don't need to hide the research findings, but be cautious about how you present them. Think before you speak.
lines.style: Calm, paternal warning. Not stern—genuinely protective. A pause before 'but' to separate permission from caution. Even tone throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、仮説を、絶対、裏付ける、絶対、データ、絶対、集めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm gathering data to support the paper's hypothesis. I appreciate your direction.
lines.style: Steady and deliberate. Each phrase carries careful intention. Slight formality that suggests respect for the seriousness of the work, not awkwardness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学界の、本気で、絶対、先代、絶対、の研究、絶対、参考にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure you reference the foundational research from the previous generation of scholars. Build on what came before.
lines.style: Slightly philosophical weight here. Slower pace. A note of respect for those who came before. Not directive, more like passing on a principle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。後輩の、本気で、絶対、小論文、絶対、指導、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm guiding my junior colleague on their short essay as well. Thank you for entrusting me with this.
lines.style: Warm close. Pride underneath—he's being trusted to mentor, and he knows it. Voice settles a little deeper. Genuine appreciation.
